_comment: The anomalies actually in rotation. HearthstoneJSON ships every anomaly ever printed (107 distinct); training on retired ones teaches a game nobody is playing. Trinkets and heroes need no list here - they are marked active by having a Firestone pick rate from live top-MMR games, so `refresh-stats` keeps them current automatically. Anomalies have no public per-anomaly stats, so this list is maintained by hand from the patch notes.
_note: 35.6 added 7, updated 5 and returned 17 = 29 distinct, which matches the wiki's current-pool list once Treasure Hoard's three tier variants collapse to one name. All 29 resolve against HearthstoneJSON by exact name.
